objective: Gate 5G-R2 quirurgico: reutilizar exactamente el contenido previsto en Gate 5G para que el Universal Worker dispare automaticamente una sola ejecucion live del canario Agent Reach mediante un push limitado a un marcador unico. Corregir exclusivamente el bloqueo WRITE_EXISTING_REQUIRES_EXPECTED_SHA256 agregando los expected_sha256 reales de los archivos existentes. No instalar Docker en Worker, no modificar Worker/Supervisor/watchdog, no secrets, no docker.sock, no mounts, no deploy, no image push, no Produccion.

actions.content:
name: Agent-Reach Live Canary

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact Edarsahub_Desarrollo SHA to certify
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - Edarsahub_Desarrollo
    paths:
      - backend/tests/live_canary_requests/gate5g_worker_autotrigger_20260914.json

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  live-canary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact SHA
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          echo "EXACT_SHA_CHECK=PASS"

      - name: Build canonical Agent-Reach image
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          infra/agent-reach/build.sh

      - name: Execute real live canary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export PYTHONPATH=backend
          python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_agent_reach_live_network_canary.py

      - name: Upload sanitized live evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agent-reach-live-canary-evidence-${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          path: backend/tests/agent_reach_live_network_canary_evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

from pathlib import Path

WORKFLOW = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / '.github' / 'workflows' / 'agent-reach-live-canary.yml'

def test_live_canary_workflow_is_sha_bound_and_worker_autotrigger_is_one_path_only():
    text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    required = [
        'workflow_dispatch:', 'expected_sha:', 'push:',
        'branches:', '- Edarsahub_Desarrollo',
        '- backend/tests/live_canary_requests/gate5g_worker_autotrigger_20260914.json',
        "EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}",
        'runs-on: ubuntu-latest', 'persist-credentials: false',
        'infra/agent-reach/build.sh', 'test_agent_reach_live_network_canary.py',
        'actions/upload-artifact@v4', 'contents: read', 'if: always()',
    ]
    for token in required:
        assert token in text
    forbidden = ['secrets.', '/var/run/docker.sock', 'docker.sock', 'docker push', 'kubectl ', 'ssh ', 'scp ', 'schedule:', 'repository_dispatch:']
    for token in forbidden:
        assert token not in text
    assert text.count('backend/tests/live_canary_requests/gate5g_worker_autotrigger_20260914.json') == 1
